Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi For the Petitioners :Mr. Bipin Kr.
Prabhat, Advocate For the State :Mrs. Ruby Pandey, A.P.P. .......
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Itkhori P.S. Case No. 90 of 2022,
registered under sections 498(A), 323, 379 of I.P.C, section 3/4 of D.P. Act pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Chatra.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners are not the family members of the husband of the informant.

He submits that the petitioners are residing in the same village and the case has been registered under section 498A of I.P.C. and other sections of the I.P.C. including section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer.
5. Considering that petitioners are not the family members of the husband of the informant and they are residing in the same village, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

Accordingly, the above named petitioners are directed to surrender before the learned Court within three weeks from today and in the event of their surrender / arrest, the petitioners shall be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (twenty five thousand)each with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Chatra, in connection with Itkhori P.S. Case No. 90 of 2022, subject to conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
